title: Tensor with a finite-Tor complex adds cohomology intervals
statement: Let C be a braided closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, and choose D(C) with its canonical K-flat derived tensor. If K has Tor amplitude [a,b] and N has cohomology concentrated in [c,d], then K tensor N has cohomology concentrated in [a+c,b+d]. No ordering, constructibility or finiteness hypothesis is required beyond these interval conditions.

proof.text: Choose a flat representative P of K supported in [a,b] by the bounded flat-model characterization of Tor amplitude. Choose a representative Q of N supported in [c,d] by the standard t-structure. The bounded complex P of flat objects is K-flat. Hence P tensor Q represents the derived tensor. Its only nonzero summands in total degree n arise from i+j=n with i in [a,b] and j in [c,d], so it vanishes outside [a+c,b+d]. This support bound gives the stated cohomological interval.
